summary: This bill doubles the tax exclusion on capital gains from the sale of a primary residence (from $250,000/$500,000 to $500,000/$1,000,000, with inflation adjustments) by amending IRC section 121, effective for sales after enactment.

scores.thoughts: The bill amends the tax code to expand an exclusion on capital gains from home sales. It does not authorize, appropriate, or modify any direct government spending programs or outlays.

The core provision doubles the existing exclusion amounts under IRC Section 121 ($250k to $500k and $500k to $1M) and adds inflation indexing. This directly reduces the taxable gain on principal residence sales, constituting a tax cut.
